podcast.title: Inspiration for "My Sharona" (1979)
podcast.body: Sharona Alperin was the 17-year-old inspiration for The Knack's hit song "My Sharona," when Doug Fieger, then 25, first saw her. She later dated Fieger from the age of 19 to 21, describing the period touring with The Knack as "magical." "Sharona is a real person. She was 17 when 25-year-old Doug Figer saw her while in the company of his girlfriend and proceeded to lose his mind."

podcast.title: Real Estate Career
podcast.body: Sharona Alperin has become a successful real estate agent in Los Angeles, famously using "mySharona" as part of her web address, and is often asked by clients if she is "that Sharona." "She has been a successful real estate agent in Los Angeles for many years. In her web address, it's my Sharona, of course."
